hotel_name: The Westin Maui Resort and Spa

claims.text: The resort has views of the Pacific, the islands of Lanai and Molokai, and Black Rock.

findings.quote: The Westin Maui Resort & Spa’s central setting provides guests with unrivaled views of the shimmering Paciﬁc and the enchanting islands of Lanai and Molokai as well as iconic Black Rock

claims.text: The family pool area has an interactive Keiki Splash Zone, and the resort has a 270-foot water slide.

findings.quote: the little ones can keep cool in the new interactive Keiki Splash Zone in the family pool area.
our iconic 270 feet water slide

claims.text: Dew-drop-shaped cabanas made from bamboo and dark wood, designed exclusively for the resort, are scattered across the pool deck.

findings.quote: Scattered across the deck and pool area are dew-drop shaped cabanas that were exclusively designed for the resort. Made from bamboo and dark wood

claims.text: Hokupa'a tower guests get larger indoor and outdoor room layouts.

findings.quote: Hōkūpa‘a Tower guests will not only find larger indoor and outdoor room layouts

claims.text: Cultural experiences at The Lanai include lei po'o making, talk story sessions, ukulele lessons, chef demonstrations and live music.

findings.quote: Our curated Hawaiian experiences include small Hawaiian breakfast bites, the making of fresh lei po‘o, Mo‘olelo "talk story" sessions, ukulele lessons, chef demonstrations, live musical events and more.

claims.text: The resort has a Heavenly Spa by Westin offering massages, facials, body treatments and couples massages.

findings.quote: Enjoy therapeutic massages, cleansing facials, and invigorating body treatments at our Maui spa.
Couples Massages

claims.text: Guests can join an outrigger canoe experience, available daily for ages 6 and up.

findings.quote: our outrigger canoe adventure experience. Available daily for ages 6 and up.

claims.text: Ulu Kitchen by Merriman is a beachfront restaurant using fresh island ingredients and food made from scratch.

findings.quote: Ulu Kitchen by Merriman features the freshest island ingredients and carefully crafted food made from scratch. Enjoy the versatile selections in this beachfront dining in West Maui.

claims.text: The Westin Family Kids Club offers arts and crafts, nature adventures, lei-making and animal expeditions.

findings.quote: The Westin Family Kids Club offers a variety of engaging activities and facilities designed for children, including arts and crafts, nature adventures, lei-making, and animal expeditions

claims.text: Whalers Village, with restaurants, shops and entertainment, is a block away.

findings.quote: Whaler's Village is only one block from our resort.
the 67 stores and 12 restaurants at this shopping mall offer nearly endless recreation and pleasure.

claims.text: The resort is oceanfront on Ka'anapali Beach.

findings.quote: The Westin Maui Resort & Spa is an oceanfront resort located on the legendary Ka‘anapali Beach.

claims.text: The Kawaiola Aquatic Playground has six pools overlooking Ka'anapali Beach across 87,000 square feet.

findings.quote: Discover six stunning pools overlooking Ka‘anapali Beach and spanning 87,000 square feet of pool playground

claims.text: Guests staying in the Hokupa'a tower get access to The Lanai, with panoramic views, Hawaiian breakfast and dinner bites, a private bar, infinity-edge cocktail pools and cultural experiences.

findings.quote: Hokupa‘a guests will be treated to panoramic views, daily artisanal Hawaiian breakfast and dinner bites, a private bar, infinity-edge cocktail pools, and cultural experiences.

claims.text: The Heavenly Spa has open-air lounge spaces with oceanfront views.

findings.quote: open-air lounge spaces that offer sunshine and oceanfront views

claims.text: The Wailele Luau features a fire knife performance, hula and a traditional island-style dinner.

findings.quote: Experience Maui's most spectacular fire knife performance. Immerse yourself in the rich culture of the Hawaiian Islands through ‘oli and hula over a traditional island-style dinner

claims.text: Kahului Airport, the main airport, is about 45 minutes from the hotel.

findings.quote: Approximately 45 minutes from our hotel, Kahului Airport (OGG) is our main airport

claims.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.

findings.quote: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

claims.text: WhataHotel notes it is a large resort with busy common areas.
